findings.title: Delete action is never shown in the list view for Grafana rules
findings.body: The Delete menu item is gated on `canDelete && rulerRule`. The list view now passes only `promRule` (GrafanaRuleListItem no longer supplies `rulerRule`), so `rulerRule` is always undefined there. `canDelete` can be true from the Grafana prom abilities, but the item is still not rendered. Users with delete permission lose the Delete action in the alert list, and the Delete button wired to `handleDelete(rulerRule, ...)` is effectively dead for this path.

findings.title: Pause menu item is gated on rulerRule and disappears in the list view
findings.body: `MenuItemPauseRule` is rendered only when `canPause && rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`. In the list view `rulerRule` is undefined, so the pause option is hidden even when the Grafana prom abilities grant pause. The ability was computed from `promRule` but the render condition still depends on the ruler rule.

findings.title: Silence button in list view opens nothing because the drawer requires rulerRule
findings.body: `handleSilence` sets `showSilenceDrawer`, but the `SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer` is rendered only when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` holds. In the list view `rule` is undefined, so the drawer never mounts. The Silence menu item (now enabled via `grafanaSilenceAbility`) appears and does nothing when clicked.

findings.title: Test asserts the broken 4-item menu as the expected behavior
findings.body: GrafanaGroupLoader.test.tsx expects exactly 4 menu items (silence, copy link, duplicate, export) and never checks pause or delete. The test therefore locks in the missing Delete and Pause actions instead of catching them, and the silence test does not verify the drawer opens.

findings.title: Removed matchRules tests with no replacement coverage
findings.body: The matchRules unit tests were deleted along with the ruler matching logic, but no tests were added for the new list-item path that handles Grafana rules without a ruler rule. Behaviour such as provenance (now read from promRule.provenance) and the is-paused source change is not covered.

findings.title: Rule view link drops the returnTo parameter
findings.body: The previous GrafanaRuleLoader built the href with `createReturnTo()` so navigating from the list back to the list works. The new href is `createRelativeUrl('/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view')` with no returnTo, so the back navigation from the rule view is lost.
